title: Fluorescent Nano-switches for diagnostics applications
protocol: Prepare and synthesize nanoparticles using the thermal decomposition method.
Cool the black colored mixture at room temperature after removing the heat source.
Precipitate the mixture using ethanol.
Magnetically separate the precipitated mixture using a rare-earth magnet.
Discard the brown supernatant.
Wash the nanoparticles once more with ethanol to remove leftover nonmagnetic product.
Synthesize DMSA-functionalized nanoparticles as previously reported in the literature.
Isolate black powders through centrifugation.
Add 1 ml of water after isolation.
Magnetically purify the solution and adjust pH to 7.
Determine the SPMNPs concentration using TGA.
Measure the size of SPMNPs using DLS or TEM respectively.
Mix 25-fold molar excess of FIASH-EDT2-Maleimide with fluorescein-conjugated DMSA functionalized SPMNPs.
Perform the reaction for overnight at room temperature.
Remove unbound fluorescein by extensive washing in the presence of a magnetic field.
Resuspend purified fluorescein conjugated SPMNPs in distilled H₂O for further cellular uptake analysis.
Resuspend magnetically purified fluorescein conjugated SPMNPs in PBS for further cellular uptake analysis.
Incubate HeLa cells with fluorescence-modified SPMNPs at 37°C for different Pulse–Chase periods.
Fix the cells in 4% paraformaldehyde and mount on a coverslip with polymount containing DAPI nucleus staining after the Pulse-Chase paradigm.
Capture images on a Zeiss Radiance 2100 confocal connected to an upright Nikon Eclipse E800 microscope using an oil immersion plan Apo 40xA/1.40 numerical aperture objective lens.
Process final images using Adobe Photoshop and restrict adjustments to limited linear color balance adjustments for interpreting merged pictures.
